title: Expansion: more distinct patients for unseen-patient practice
description: Twelve patients not used in any other pack: four LCTSC thoracic planning CTs with RT organ-at-risk contours (three institutions), three LIDC-IDRI nodule CTs with multi-reader outlines plus the same patients' radiographs (interval unknown), two C4KC-KiTS arterial CTs with kidney/tumour SEG (tumour on the left in one, right in the other, by SEG centroid), two Spine-Mets-CT-SEG CTs with vertebral-level SEGs, and one ReMIND pre-operative brain MRI (T1 post-contrast, FLAIR, T2) with a manual glioma SEG.
